answer: Sybil resistance leverages Proof-of-Stake identity, demanding agents lock valuable computational assets to register. This digital stake, like securing a digital **wharf** for legitimate operations, is costly. Attacking requires a proportional asset expenditure per Sybil, analogous to traversing an economic **tundra** for each fake agent. Any malicious activity leaves an immutable transaction **plume**, risking stake slashing and imposing immense economic costs on an attacker.
